content.cn:
v26.2.3 正式发布！本版本集中修复了数据路径、窗口恢复与触屏滚动上的几个老问题。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除便携模式开关，数据固定在安装目录并自动从 AppData 迁移
- 修复启动后窗口变细条：非法尺寸拒绝写入，并按习惯尺寸自愈（默认 1280×720）
- 数据向下兼容：未知字段保留不删，回退旧版仍可读取
- 禁用触屏滑到底部的回弹；点名滚动减少 DOM 重渲染

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.3 is now officially released. This release focuses on long-standing issues around data paths, window restore, and touch scrolling.

Highlights include:

- Portable mode removed; data always lives under the install directory with automatic AppData migration
- Fixed the thin-strip window on startup: illegal sizes are rejected and restored from habitual size (default 1280×720)
- Downward-compatible data: unknown fields are preserved so rolling back still works
- Disabled touch overscroll bounce; roller hot path reduces DOM re-renders

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.2 正式发布！本版本在不减少任何视觉效果的前提下降低 CPU 与内存占用，让程序在老旧平台上更加流畅。

本次更新重点包括：

- 横幅倒计时改为合成器驱动动画，视觉逐帧一致，主线程不再每 100ms 更新
- 构建分包优化冷启动（入口包 814KB → 445KB）
- 保留全部动画效果，性能模式行为与旧版完全一致
- Windows 安装器自动适配系统语言（中文/英文）、显示 GPL-3.0 许可证、图标与程序一致

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.2 is now officially released. This version reduces CPU and memory usage without removing any visual effects, making the app smoother on older hardware.

Highlights include:

- Banner countdowns are compositor-driven with frame-identical visuals; no more per-100ms main-thread updates
- Build splitting improves cold start (entry chunk 814KB → 445KB)
- All visual effects preserved; performance-mode behavior identical to the previous version
- The Windows installer auto-adapts to the system language (Chinese/English), shows the GPL-3.0 license, and uses the app icon

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.1 正式发布！本版本修复了 v26.2.0 的构建失败问题，并恢复 Release、GitHub Pages 与插件 SDK 的发布流程。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除设置页中重复声明的悬浮窗样式同步函数，修复构建失败
- 发布流程全面统一使用 bun，安装、测试与构建更加稳定

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.1 is now officially released. This version fixes the v26.2.0 build failure and restores the Release, GitHub Pages, and Plugin SDK publishing pipelines.

Highlights include:

- Removed duplicate floating-window style sync declarations in Settings that broke the build
- All publishing pipelines now consistently use bun for more stable installs, tests, and builds

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.1.0 正式发布！本版本完成了插件平台、桌面运行时、导航动画与数据导入体验的集中升级，Web 与 Tauri 桌面端现已提供正式版本。

本次更新重点包括：

- 完整插件系统：在线安装、更新、卸载、依赖、纯净恢复模式与本地 `.cnrp` 调试
- 宿主原生 Fluent 插件页面、跨平台能力桥接，以及名单、记录、统计和平衡数据只读保护
- 插件可贡献独立页面和 Dock 栏功能入口，并支持插件 SDK 1.1 运行时
- 覆盖式二级 Dock 菜单，GSAP 页面转场与 Dock 活动竖线动画
- 官方插件模板、Fluent 组件/API Pages 与『来点音效』v1.1.0 示例插件
- Tauri `cyrenenr` URI、Web Hash 一次性参数及指定 Roller 配置后自动开始滚动
- 跨管理员权限单实例 IPC、双模式开机启动、启动到托盘与启动动画时序修复
- 人员性别与 Roller 性别筛选、公平算法状态标识、新成员统计初始化策略
- CSV/JSON/XLSX/CYRENE 智能拖入导入及名单身份信息保护
- 通知横幅统一支持关闭，压缩 MiSans 字体以减少桌面端体积
- 正式移除 Electron 支持，后续核心版本仅维护 Web 与 Tauri

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.1.0 is now officially released. This version brings a coordinated upgrade to the plugin platform, desktop runtime, navigation animations, and import experience. The Web and Tauri desktop builds are now available as stable releases.

Highlights include:

- A complete plugin system with catalog install, update, uninstall, dependencies, clean recovery, and local `.cnrp` debugging
- Host-rendered native Fluent plugin pages, cross-platform bridges, and read-only protection for lists, records, statistics, and balance data
- Independent plugin pages and functional Dock entries, backed by the plugin API 1.1 runtime
- Overlay secondary Dock menus, GSAP page transitions, and animated Dock active indicators
- The official plugin template, Fluent components/API Pages, and the usable Sound Effects v1.1.0 example plugin
- The `cyrenenr` desktop URI scheme, Web hash one-time parameters, and direct Roller startup with supplied settings
- Cross-elevation single-instance IPC, two startup methods, startup-to-tray, and splash timing fixes
- Gender-aware draws, fairness status, and configurable new-member statistics initialization
- Smart CSV/JSON/XLSX/CYRENE drag-and-drop import with identity preservation
- Dismissible notification banners and compressed MiSans fonts for smaller desktop builds
- Electron development and releases have ended; future core versions target Web and Tauri

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.
